rows.meaning: A min_keep outside 0..2147483647 is refused with HTTP 400 naming the hard bounds, so clients must send an in-range integer and treat the 400 as their own request error.

live.message: Field 'min_keep': Value must be between 0 <= value <= 2147483647, but got -1

no_rows.reason: Bool field with no limits or handler: sending true is stored verbatim and reported as true, identical to the value sent, so it is an identity outcome; the same field sent as the number 1 is refused with a json type_error 302 message that carries no bounds text, so no countable reject exists either (line 187 declares it; no limits line).
